findings.route_reason: The reviewer routed this debt itself and approved alongside it. It is not specific to M12's ceiling — the same module tail gates the pre-existing invariant and regression rules identically — and nothing in this PR's diff made it worse. The wording half of its acceptance is being taken now (one sentence), because a triage note that overstates what it grades is the exact defect this PR exists to remove; the mechanism half is left as debt.
findings.claim: The R8 repair grades `main()`'s return value but not the module tail that turns it into a process exit code, so `evals/run.py:179` changing from `sys.exit(main())` to `main()` silently disables the wall-clock gate (and the invariant and regression gates with it) while `fast-wall-clock-budget` stays green.
findings.evidence: evals/run.py:178-179 is the only thing CI and `.githooks/pre-commit` (`python -m evals.run --suite fast`) actually read, and `src/browser/eval_adapter.py:1044-1067` `_main_exit_code` calls `R.main()` in-process, never the `__main__` guard. Measured in a scratch copy: with `WALL_BUDGET_S = {"fast": 60, "invariant": 0}` and the tail unmodified, `python -m evals.run --suite invariant --no-report` exits 1; with the tail changed to a bare `main()` the same over-budget run exits 0, and `run_case(fast-wall-clock-budget)` still returns `{'passed': True, 'main_exit': [{54.35, exit 0, got 0}, {79.02, exit 1, got 1}]}`. The case's triage note claims it grades "the exit code of the code path CI and `.githooks/pre-commit` actually take", which is one line short of true.
findings.repro: cp -a the worktree to a scratch dir; `sed -i '' 's/sys.exit(main())/main()/' evals/run.py`; `python -m evals.run --suite fast --no-report; echo $?` on an over-budget tree -> 0, and `python -c "import json,src.browser.eval_adapter as A; print(A.run_case(json.load(open('evals/adversarial/fast-wall-clock-budget.json')))['passed'])"` -> True.
findings.acceptance: Either the case drives the process (`subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'evals.run', ...])` for one over-budget probe and reads `returncode`), or the triage/ADR wording drops the claim that it grades the path CI takes and names the module tail as ungraded. Non-blocking: this is the same regress one level up, it is not specific to M12's ceiling (it disables the pre-existing invariant and regression gates identically), and nothing in the diff made it worse.
